title: YNX Card — Controlled Testnet Card Preview
metaDescription: Explore the YNX Card Testnet Preview with sandbox card lifecycle, user-configurable controls, signed provider events, privacy export and bounded account-data deletion.
h1: A controlled Card preview for YNX Testnet

runtimeTruth.secureDisplay: Provider-hosted secure display is required for any future official issuer; YNX does not persist PAN, CVV, PIN or track data.

features: Sandbox application, issuance, activation, freeze, unfreeze, replacement and closure
Spend, online, international, ATM, MCC and country controls
Bounded webhook-key rotation and fail-closed event ordering
Privacy export with provider-sensitive reference redaction
Bounded retention and account deletion with issuer closure, pseudonymized audit and dedicated authorization scope
Dispute initiation and review-only AI explanations
risks: This preview is not a real-world payment card and has no BIN or production issuer relationship.
Issuer availability, fees, rewards, jurisdiction and consumer protections depend on a future approved provider program.
No hosted download, public runtime, production signature or store release is currently evidenced.

faq.question: Can YNX Card be used for real purchases?
faq.answer: No. The current product is a Testnet Preview using an unavailable or deterministic sandbox issuer and is not a spendable real-world card.

faq.question: Does YNX store card numbers or CVV data?
faq.answer: No. PAN, CVV, PIN and track data are forbidden from YNX application state, logs, analytics, AI context and public evidence.

faq.question: What happens when the issuer is unavailable?
faq.answer: The product fails closed, reports degraded health and returns not-ready status instead of fabricating a card or successful provider state.

faq.question: Is the mobile app available to download?
faq.answer: Not yet. Source and local bundle evidence exist, but native install, hosted artifact, production signing and store-release evidence remain incomplete.
